description: The clip view of an arrangement's MIDI clip: a Clip box (switch, name, start and end or loop position and length in bars.beats.16ths, signature, Loop) and a Notes box (transpose, invert, reverse, legato, ×2, ÷2, humanize, velocity ramps) beside its piano roll (Draw, Fold, the loop brace on the ruler, keys, grid, a velocity or chance lane). Notes are drawn a grid step at a time. Folds down to its title.
name: midi-clip-panel
